item.title: Here’s What Democrats Plan to Do With Their Power if They Win Back Congress

item.title: Israeli Settlers Turn a Palestinian Rite Into a Gantlet of Violence and Fear
item.description: This year’s olive harvest in the Israeli-occupied West Bank is the most violent in years, as settlers have attacked farmers and besieged homes, drawing condemnation from U.S. officials and others.

item.media:description: Palestinians harvesting olives last week in Khirbet Abu Falah, in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Israeli settlers attacked a group of Palestinians there last week, injuring several people, including an American journalist.
